combinations.name: Mount Crystal Lens onto Lantern
combinations.text: You mount the void crystal inside the lantern housing. The flame turns brilliant spectral blue, cutting through deep shadows.

combinations.name: Combine Ash Dust with Empty Vial
combinations.text: You combine the fine grey ash with liquid residue inside the glass vial, producing an invigorating clarity elixir.

combinations.name: Hone Razor Edge with Glass Shard
combinations.text: You scrape the razor against the razor-sharp bevel of the glass shard, giving it a vicious cutting edge.

combinations.name: Bind Entity Cloth to Void Crystal
combinations.text: You bind the floating entity cloth around the crystal core, fashioning a talisman that wards off creeping dread.
